categoryId.description: The id of the category for the spending goal, either from the /categories endpoint or **std:all**

periodType.description: The period type of the goal, can be annual or monthly

periodStart.description: You can set a goal period to start on a certain date. DD when periodType is monthly, DD-MM when periodType is annual

value.description: The amount of the spending goal in minor units of the currency, eg. pennies for GBP.
